HEADER: Init +8; Senses All-around vision, Darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +24
DEFENSE: AC 26, touch 15; flat-footed 21 (+4 armor [-4 without mage armor], +4 dex, +1 dodge, +7 natural)
Immune Death, Earth, Petrification/Statue; Resist Dark 10, Ice 5; Strong Lightning
OFFENSE: Melee +2 Dagger +20/+15/+10 (1d4+4/19-20), snake bite +13 (1d4+1 plus poison)
2nd (DC 17) - Entomb II, Poison, Stone II, Stone Call
3rd (DC 18) - Bio, Entomb III, Sleepga, Slow, Stone III, Stonera
4th (DC 19) - Break, Rock Spikes, Stone IV, Stoneskin
STATISTICS: Str 14, Dex 19, Con 24, Int 20, Wis 16, Cha 20
Feats Combat Casting, Clustered Shots, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (Longbow)
Skills Bluff +19, Climb +19, Disguise +19, Intimidate +20, Knowledge (Dungeoneering) +19, Perception +24, Survival +19, Stealth +21; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception
SPECIAL ABILITIES: All-around Vision (ex) An earth medusa's snake-hair allows her to see in all directions. Medusa gain a +4 racial bonus to Perception checks and cannot be flanked.

Petrify (su) An earth medusa can focus her stony gaze upon a single target within 30 feet. The target receives the Petrification status effect (Fortitude save DC 22 to negate). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 23).

Petrifying Gaze (su) 2/day, an earth medusa turns it victims to stone permanently within a 30-ft.-cone radius. Everyone within the effect must make a Fortitude DC 22 to negate the Petrification status effect. This is a gaze attack. The save DC is Charisma-based.
Poison (ex) Bite—injury; save Fort DC 24; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d4 Str; cure 2 consecutive saves. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Stone Breath (su) Once every 1d4+1 rounds, an earth medusa can breath out a dry gray breath hitting all those within a 30-ft. cone. The targets within the area of effect receive the Statue status effect (Fortitude save DC 22 to negate). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 7th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 31).

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
